from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689839/attempts/999ba5f7203e4d1c9459d496b4c7cec5/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    hseps = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r])) == 1]
    vseps = [c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def regions(n, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for k in cuts:
            if k > start: out.append((start,k))
            start=k+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    row_regions = regions(h, hseps)
    col_regions = regions(w, vseps)
    # The distinctive panel is the one with the most cells differing from the
    # common background; copy its local pattern to every panel.
    panels = []
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(row_regions):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(col_regions):
            vals=[g[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
            panels.append((sum(v != 1 for v in vals),ri,ci,(r0,r1,c0,c1)))
    _, sri, sci, (sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1) = max(panels)
    pattern=[row[sc0:sc1] for row in g[sr0:sr1]]
    for r0,r1 in row_regions:
        for c0,c1 in col_regions:
            if (r1-r0,c1-c0)!=(len(pattern),len(pattern[0])):
                continue
            for dr in range(r1-r0):
                g[r0+dr][c0:c1]=pattern[dr][:]
    return g
'''
path=programs/'task-4eed77c3.py'
path.write_text(code)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_transform',path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo_in=[[6,6,2,1,1],[8,1,2,1,1],[1,1,2,1,1],[2,2,2,2,2],[1,1,2,1,1],[1,1,2,1,1],[1,1,2,1,1],[2,2,2,2,2],[1,1,2,1,1],[1,1,2,1,1],[1,1,2,1,1]]
demo_out=[[6,6,2,6,6],[8,1,2,8,1],[1,1,2,1,1],[2,2,2,2,2],[6,6,2,6,6],[8,1,2,8,1],[1,1,2,1,1],[2,2,2,2,2],[6,6,2,6,6],[8,1,2,8,1],[1,1,2,1,1]]
print('demo match:',mod.transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
test=[[1,1,1,4,1,1,1,4,1,1,1] for _ in range(17)]
for r in (5,11): test[r]=[4]*11
for r,row in {6:[1,1,7],7:[9,1,1],8:[1,7,1]}.items(): test[r][:3]=row
out=mod.transform(test)
print('test output:')
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
print('saved:',path)
